Step.SQLStatement: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS sp005_taxrateat(numeric, timestamp, varchar)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sp005_taxrateat(p_c_taxcategory_id numeric, p_validfrom timestamp without time zone, issotrx character varying) RETURNS numeric LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ DECLARE v_CurrentTax NUMERIC; BEGIN -- Get Cost At SELECT t.Rate INTO v_CurrentTax FROM C_Tax t WHERE t.C_TaxCategory_ID = p_C_TaxCategory_ID AND t.ValidFrom <= p_ValidFrom AND (t.IsSalesTax = issotrx OR (issotrx = 'Y' AND (t.SOPOType = 'B' OR t.SOPOType = 'S')) OR (issotrx = 'N' AND (t.SOPOType = 'B' OR t.SOPOType = 'P')) ) ORDER BY t.ValidFrom, t.IsDefault DESC LIMIT 1; -- DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('== FTA_FarmerLiquidation_ID=' || p_FTA_FarmerLiquidation_ID || ', Amt=' || v_AvailableAmt); -- Valid if is null Value IF v_CurrentTax IS NULL THEN v_CurrentTax := 0; END IF; -- Default Return RETURN v_CurrentTax; END $function$ ;
